DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) due to occupational dust exposure.

Given your history of chronic cough, dyspnea on exertion, hyperinflation on X-ray, and significant exposure to dust and fumes as a landscaper, the clinical picture strongly supports COPD rather than asthma, especially with your lack of childhood history and absence of wheezing. I recommend starting a spirometry test to confirm the degree of airflow obstruction and to guide treatment.
